rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs of AVMA, its constituent organizations, recognized specialty groups and accredited veterinary institutions; state veterinary medical or veterinary technician associations; AAVSB RACE-approved programs; other board-approved programs. Online live or recorded allowed beyond the in-person minimum
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required at the initial renewal if the licensee graduated within that biennium.
rules.notes: Registered veterinary technicians: 10 h per biennium, min 6 h medical, max 4 h practice management; at least 4 h in person. Registrations expire March 1 of odd-numbered years.
